name: Sky
description: A Sky tab in the dev tools' menu (forge mode: F3, D-pad right or X) with the look of the sky and its fog: the map's own, sunset, night and fog tints of the map's sky, then skies a shader draws: clear day, golden sunset, night with stars, overcast, alien dusk. Left and right change it. In a system link game the host changes it for every machine.
